scene-u01-pnew1-3.name: text#3
scene-u01-pnew1-3.text: Week 13 · KP02 Formal definition of the HMM

scene-u01-pnew1-5.name: text#5
scene-u01-pnew1-5.text: An HMM is defined by four things: number of states, transitions, emissions and initial probabilities

scene-u01-pnew1-6.name: text#6
scene-u01-pnew1-6.text: How to read: the left draws all four parts on one model (purple: states, blue: transitions, teal: emissions, amber: initial); the right gives each meaning and constraint.

scene-u01-pnew1-46.name: text#46
scene-u01-pnew1-46.text: Purple circles: states; blue arrows: transitions; teal arrows: emissions; amber arrows: first-step state

scene-u01-pnew1-50.name: text#50
scene-u01-pnew1-50.text: We use the Moore type: an observation is emitted on arriving at a state; each state visited emits one observation.

scene-u01-pnew1-62.name: text#62
scene-u01-pnew1-62.text: From $j$ before to $i$ now; for every $j$, $\sum_{i=1}^{K_s}P(i\mid j)=1$

scene-u01-pnew1-67.name: text#67
scene-u01-pnew1-67.text: Density of emitting $\mathbf{x}$ in state $i$; a probability for discrete symbols

scene-u01-pnew1-72.name: text#72
scene-u01-pnew1-72.text: Probability the first step is in state $i$; they sum to $1$

scene-u01-pnew1-74.name: text#74
scene-u01-pnew1-74.text: Three states and two-way arrows are a sketch

scene-u01-pnew2-3.name: text#3
scene-u01-pnew2-3.text: Week 13 · KP02 Formal definition of the HMM

scene-u01-pnew2-5.name: text#5
scene-u01-pnew2-5.text: A left-to-right model never goes back: all entries below the diagonal are $0$, each row sums to $1$

scene-u01-pnew2-6.name: text#6
scene-u01-pnew2-6.text: How to read: three circles left to right; arcs are self-transitions, solid arrows move forward, dashed arrows are forbidden returns; the right writes the model as a matrix beside a general model.

scene-u01-pnew2-53.name: text#53
scene-u01-pnew2-53.text: Arcs: self-transitions; solid: forward; dashed: return, probability $0$; below each circle, $P_i(H)$ is the chance state $i$ emits $H$

scene-u01-pnew2-57.name: text#57
scene-u01-pnew2-57.text: "No self-transitions, or it gets stuck" is wrong: self-transitions mean staying; only going back is forbidden.

scene-u01-pnew2-59.name: text#59
scene-u01-pnew2-59.text: Transition matrix of the same model

scene-u01-pnew2-110.name: text#110
scene-u01-pnew2-110.text: When $i<j$, $P(i\mid j)=0$: everything below the diagonal is $0$.

scene-u01-pnew3-3.name: text#3
scene-u01-pnew3-3.text: Week 13 · KP02 Formal definition of the HMM

scene-u01-pnew3-5.name: text#5
scene-u01-pnew3-5.text: One path has probability $0.027648$; only $7$ of $81$ paths are legal, with far fewer parameters

scene-u01-pnew3-6.name: text#6
scene-u01-pnew3-6.text: How to read: the four top-left cells multiply into one path probability; each lower-left dot is a path (green: legal); the right compares parameter counts and the two HMM tasks.

scene-u01-pnew3-36.name: text#36
scene-u01-pnew3-36.text: $81$ paths, one per dot; the $7$ green ones are legal

scene-u01-pnew3-135.name: text#135
scene-u01-pnew3-135.text: Such as $1,2,1,3$, which goes from state $2$ back to $1$:

scene-u01-pnew3-136.name: text#136
scene-u01-pnew3-136.text: $P(1\mid2)=0$, so the whole path has probability $0$.

scene-u01-pnew3-164.name: text#164
scene-u01-pnew3-164.text: Given known sequences of one class, estimate that class's HMM parameters.

scene-u01-pnew3-168.name: text#168
scene-u01-pnew3-168.text: Given an unknown sequence and $M$ models, pick the best match:

scene-u01-pnew3-173.name: text#173
scene-u01-pnew3-173.text: There are $K_s^N$ paths; summing them all gives $p(X\mid\mathcal{S})$. How?
